title: Opening the Black Box of Virtual Education: Medical Students’ Learning and Study Strategies
reason: Cross-sectional LASSI questionnaire (learning and study strategies) compared across GPA bands, gender and repeat-course history during virtual education. Strategy data are self-report and GPA is not an LMS indicator; no platform-recorded indicator or activity product is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: This cross-sectional study included 298 medical students in preclinical disciplines in the medical curriculum at Mashhad
extraction.population: basic-science and preclinical medical students, 1 university
extraction.outcome_or_construct: learning and study strategies (LASSI, self-report); GPA
extraction.notes: Strategy-GPA differences are reported as group means and p-values only.
